_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: every letter moves the same way, or one letter's place is squared; 2: moves that take turns (+5, −5; −1, +1), or the places added up; 3: moves that grow (+1, +2, +3…) or change sign (+3, −4, +5), or the places added and then squared, rooted or halved; 4: two rules at once (opposite letters and a swap, numbers and letters traded, a word written backwards, counting from Z, letters taken in a new order). Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
